{{Quote|I am Captain Gideon, and I trust you will find your accommodations comfortable.|Captain Gideon|<ref name="LONH" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Gideon''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and leader of the [[Suwanee Pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Welcome aboard my vessel, the ''Fereallis''.|Captain Gideon|<ref name="LONH" />}}
[[File:TL-1200_Transport_LoNH.png|thumb|left|200px|Gideon's TL-1200 transport, the ''Fereallis'']]
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Gideon and his crew operated in and around [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] preying on unsuspecting ships by pretending their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Fereallis]]'', was damaged. Sending out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] would wait for their "rescuers" to find their [[TL-1200 transport/Legends|TL-1200 transport]] which would appear to be damaged and venting [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Once the victims had boarded the ''Fereallis'' to render aid, the pirates would ambush them and confiscate whatever valuables they wished.<ref name="LONH" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We are simply going to search your vessel for anything of value, and then you can be on your way. Should any of you decide to resist paying your share of this customs duty, you will find yourself missing more than just your belongings.|Captain Gideon|<ref name="LONH" />}}
Gideon was a typical Devaronian with [[Color/Legends|white]] horns, red skin and a rakish grin. This, combined with his [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] and [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]], only augmented his ominous appearance and made him a formidable adversary. However, Gideon was not entirely vicious in his conduct. If they did not resist his crew stealing their cargo and valuables, he would allow his victims to take their ship and depart unharmed.<ref name="LONH" />
